tie_rule: Rank by full-precision distance D ascending; equal D ordered by candidate id ascending. Rounded display values that look equal are not ties.
planetary_differences: Atmospheric pressure: Mars surface pressure is ~0.6 kPa (about 0.6% of Earth's 101 kPa); no Earth site is comparable.
Gravity: Mars surface gravity is 3.71 m/s2 versus Earth's 9.81 m/s2.
Radiation: Mars has no global magnetic field and a thin atmosphere, so surface radiation dose is far higher than anywhere on Earth.
Temperature: Mars mean surface temperatures are far below any Earth analog; thermal comparisons are qualitative only.
Elevation datum: Mars elevations are relative to the MOLA areoid (GMM3), Earth elevations to the EGM2008 geoid; absolute elevations are therefore shown but never differenced.
